client_context: Mine dry / change facility at a Sudbury mine site. Proposal concept visuals for a site-services RFP response by Source Atlantic.
footprint: Approximately 48 ft x 42 ft interior, single storey, concrete floor.
layout: Main entrance at the south wall: black-framed glass double doors with dark safety mats just inside.
Immediately left (west wall) when walking in: a long clothing rack hung with orange hi-vis coveralls with reflective striping.
Mid-room, west side: a row with a boot-wash grate pad, orange boot cubbies (2 rows x 6 columns), and a 2-ft-deep storage block.
Center of the open room: five parallel drying rails hung with rows of orange coveralls.
A small wooden bench in the open area.
The north-west portion of the room is open to the rest of the building (no wall, labeled 'open to building').

Right (east) side: two parallel hallways, each 7 ft wide. The upper hallway (yellow-coded) has a vending machine at its entrance and serves a bathroom at its north end, plus a change room and bathroom on its east side. The lower hallway (pink-coded) serves a change room and bathroom on its east side and a bathroom at its south end.
Change rooms have wooden benches; bathrooms have a toilet and sink each.

innovations.name: TV Innovation Hub
innovations.description: A freestanding navy media wall with a large wall-mounted TV screen near the building-side entry of the dry, with two stools; displays live safety metrics, shift notices, and continuous-improvement ideas.

innovations.name: Micro-Market Vending
innovations.description: Two modern glass-front smart-vending micro-market units in a dedicated zone near the main entry, separate from the hallway vending, stocked with PPE consumables and quick supplies.

style: Clean professional architectural visualization for a client proposal. Realistic materials: painted concrete block walls in warm grey, sealed concrete floor, safety-orange coveralls, hi-vis yellow/silver reflective striping. Bright even industrial lighting. No people, no text overlays, no watermarks.
